findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Kitchen: cease use of laminate wrap on shelves; walls and ceiling should be light colored; repair holes in ceiling and walls; self closer on back door; triple sink large enough to support biggest piece of equipment; cut flush and paint all spray foam; seal left side of triple sink to wall (drainboard); secure hand sink to wall; cease use of acoustic ceiling tiles.
Prep space
Ceiling tiles should be smooth, nonabsorbent, easily cleanable. Seal floor to wall.

Lighting: more lighting in prep space. Shatterproof or shielded bulbs

Storage space: shelving smooth, nonabsorbent, easily cleanable - painted and seal wall to floor

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: REPEAT-Bar hand sink is not caulked to the wall. Discussed with PIC, and PIC said she would have it caulked to the wall as soon as possible. Ensure this is caulked to the wall so that the surface transition is smooth, durable, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed there to be no caulking around bar sink. Educated PIC on proper caulking to allow smooth and easily cleanable surfaces. Ensure the back edge of the sink is caulked to the wall to render it smooth and easily cleanable.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11:  HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels

Handsink in the kitchen and bar areas lacks soap and paper towels. Discussed with PIC, ensure handsinks are stocked at all times with supplies.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
No test strips were available at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure test strips are available on-site to properly test sanitizer concentration.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11:  HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels

Handsink in the kitchen area lacks soap and paper towels. Discussed with PIC, ensure handsinks are stocked at all times with supplies. COS-PIC provided soap and towels to the handsink.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

Hand sink behind bar is blocked by rubber mats. 
Hand sink in kitchen displays wash rags and steel wool inside. 
Manager stated bartenders place the rags in there to dry. Inspector advised that another drying method/place must be utilized by bartenders in the future as this is a bad practice. Hand sinks must be accessible at all times. 
Advised, regarding the kitchen sink, that hand sinks must be used for handwashing only and no dishwashing/storage of dishwashing equipment may be stored now. 

Cease these practices while in operation.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

Observed that soda guns in the bar areas to be soiled with slime. Discussed with the person in charge (PIC) and directed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation. PIC during the inspection stated that the people who maintain the system suggest water or soda water for overnight soaking. Water by itself is not a safe solution as it does not hinder bacterial growth.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily clean able.

Observed the counter in the back women's bathroom to have a piece chipped out and the inner wood exposed. Discussed with the PIC and suggested sealing the wood so that the surface is smooth and easily clean able.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

Observed the hand sink in the back bar to not have soap or hand drying devices. All sinks intended for hand washing should have a supply of hand soap and an approved method of hand drying. Discussed with the PIC and a supply will be acquired prior to the next inspection.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

Repeat. Observed a sticky puddle of spilled soda syrup in the corner by the containers of syrup in the back bar. Discussed with the PIC and instructed to clean the floors in order to keep clean.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

Facility does not currently have a FSSMC employed. Facility was moved up to a medium risk Jan 1 and secede the practices that moved them up to a medium risk. Facility's current practices are consistent with a low risk facility and they should have been reduced back to that classifications prior to this inspection.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed a clean knife stored in between the three compartment sink and the wall. juncture.  Clean utensils cannot be stored in between equipment.  Store utensils in a clean place.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed wastewater in a mop bucket.  Wastewater must be dumped immediately. Waste water was dumped during the inspection.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.comment:

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
